QuestInfo.name: [Kanna] A New Home
QuestInfo.0: A missive from Princess Sakuno arrives.
QuestInfo.1: A missive from Princess Sakuno arrives.
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno said that they'd made so much progress at Honnou-ji, it could be called a new home. With the princess's support, Kanna felt even more of their power return.
